description: Branded packaged food and pet food maker (Cheerios, Pillsbury, Blue Buffalo).

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-09-23 (Wednesday, before the open), 4 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 0.72.
catalyst.why: It must show weak volumes or a guidance cut that breaks the recent beat streak and forces estimate cuts.

reasons: Both EPS revisions in the last 30 days are downward, with consensus FY EPS slipping from 3.078 to 3.071, signaling analysts are cutting estimates into the print.
Reported net income jumped 562.5% quarter-over-quarter, but cash fell 42.2% and equity fell 21.1%, suggesting the earnings quality is deteriorating even as headline profit rises.

At 11.8x forward earnings, GIS trades on a multiple that assumes stability, yet the company just exited yogurt and Brazil/China Haagen-Dazs while buying premium pet food, adding execution risk to weak volumes.

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-12-23 report, with the long leg expiring 2027-01-15, which gives the deterioration time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The 11.2% conservative credit ratio clears the 10% floor, but the net debit is $3,830 and the short put expires in under a month, so the credit is thin relative to the downside window. Could sell more short puts if the stock holds above 35 into the print.
